mails.subject: Varmen i 2. sal
mails.body:
Hej, der er iskoldt i det store åbne rum på 2. sal igen i dag. Radiatoren ved vinduerne er helt kold, og vi sidder med jakker på. Det har været sådan siden mandag. Kan i få nogen til at kigge på det i løbet af ugen? Mvh Mikkel
Sendt fra min iPhone

mails.subject: Urgent: access card failure and unsecured door, Halvorsen & Lind Advisory
mails.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

I am writing on behalf of Halvorsen & Lind Advisory, which rents a four-desk private office on the third floor under contract no. HL-2291.

This morning at 07:50, two of our staff members were unable to enter the building. Their access cards, issued in August, were rejected at both the street door and the third floor door. The reader displayed a red light each time. One colleague is still standing outside and has no means of reaching the office.

In addition, when a neighbouring tenant let one of our staff members in, we found that the third floor door does not latch properly and remained slightly open. Our office contains client files and several unlocked laptops, and we consider this a security matter that cannot wait.

We therefore ask that:
1. the two cards be reactivated or replaced today;
2. someone inspect the third floor door lock before noon;
3. you confirm to me by telephone or email which of these have been done.

I can be reached on +45 55 01 23 45 throughout the morning. We would appreciate a written account of the cause once the situation has been resolved.

Yours faithfully,
Ingrid Solvang
Office Manager, Halvorsen & Lind Advisory
mails.justification: A tenant company reports staff locked out by non-working cards and a door that does not latch, which is a complaint with a same-day security component needing a human reply.

mails.subject: La Lettre du Quai, octobre : rentrée des espaces partagés
mails.body:
Bonjour,

Voici votre sélection du mois sur la vie des espaces de travail partagés en Europe du Nord.

Au sommaire : trois lieux qui ont repensé leurs salles de réunion pour le travail hybride, un entretien avec la responsable d'un réseau de coworkings de quartier, et notre guide des événements d'octobre à Copenhague.

À lire aussi : un comparatif des outils de réservation de salles utilisés par les petits espaces.

Vous recevez cet e-mail car vous êtes abonné à La Lettre du Quai. Pour vous désabonner, cliquez sur le lien en bas de page.

L'équipe du Quai
mails.justification: A subscribed monthly newsletter about coworking spaces, with nothing to answer, so it is a wanted newsletter with urgency 1 and no human reply.

mails.subject: Thank you for the weekend
mails.body:
Hi all,

Just a quick note before I forget. I used the quiet room on Saturday to finish our grant application and it was exactly what I needed. Silent, bright, and the coffee machine behaved for once.

We submitted at 21:10, so I wanted to say thanks to whoever kept the building open late. Nothing to do on your side, I just wanted you to know it helped a lot.

Have a good Sunday,
Aino
mails.justification: A member sends a late-night thank-you with no question or request, so it is an informational message in the other category with no reply needed.

mails.subject: Black scarf + a mystery charger? 🧣
mails.body:
Hey team! 👋

Hope the week is off to a good start. Two things, one lost and one sort of random.

First, I think I left a dark grey wool scarf somewhere on the ground floor last Thursday, probably over a chair near the kitchen or in the phone booth by the stairs. It was a gift from my sister so I'd really like to get it back. 😅

Second, and this is just curiosity: while I was looking around, I found a white laptop charger with a little yellow sticker plugged in behind the sofa in the lounge. It's not mine. I left it there, but I figured someone might be missing it, so maybe worth putting a note on the board?

Also, completely unrelated, do you know if there is a bike pump anywhere in the building? Mine has gone flat twice this month and I keep forgetting to buy one. If not, no stress at all.

No rush on any of this, whenever someone has a minute!

Thanks a lot,
Jonas
mails.justification: A member asks about a lost scarf and a few miscellaneous questions that fit no other category, with no date pressure, so it is other with a reply needed within the week.

mails.subject: Spørgsmål om fast skrivebord og prøvedag
mails.body:
Hej,

Jeg er freelance grafiker og leder efter en fast arbejdsplads i Københavns centrum fra november. Jeg har set på jeres hjemmeside, at et fast skrivebord koster 2.950 kr. om måneden, men er moms og kaffe inkluderet i den pris?

Har I et ledigt skrivebord i det stille område, og kan jeg komme forbi til en prøvedag først? Jeg har læst, at den koster 150 kr.

Med venlig hilsen
Sofie Lindgren

mails.subject: Proposal to host a half-day workshop in November
mails.body:
Dear Colleagues,

On behalf of the Nordic Learning Institute, I am writing to propose a half-day workshop on adult learning and digital skills, which we would like to host in your community space during the second half of November 2026.

We expect approximately 30 participants from small organisations in the Greater Copenhagen area. We would require a room with a projector and flexible seating, and we would be glad to contribute to costs and to open two seats to your members.

Separately, a colleague of mine, who is not part of our team, has asked whether a meeting room can be rented for a single day for an internal strategy session. No date has been chosen yet. Could you indicate your general terms for such a booking?

We would be grateful for a reply in the coming days.

Yours sincerely,
Dr. Helena Voss
Programme Director, Nordic Learning Institute
mails.justification: An institution proposes hosting a workshop next month, which is an event proposal needing a reply within the week, with a passing question about renting a room for a day without a date.
